english_title: 14. When Hostility was shown to him

phrases.arabic: يَامَنْ لاَ يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ أَنْبَآءُ الْمُتَظَلِّمِينَ
phrases.english: 1.O He from whom is not concealed news of the aggrieved!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يَحْتَاجُ فِي قِصَصِهِمْ إلَى شَهَادَاتِ الشَّاهِدِينَ
phrases.english: 2.O He who has no need to be told about them by the witnessing of the witnesses!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ قَرُبَتْ نُصْرَتُهُ مِنَ الْمَظْلُومِينَ
phrases.english: 3.O He who whose help is near to the wronged!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ بَعُدَ عَوْنُهُ عَنِ الظَّالِمِينَ قَدْ عَلِمْتَ
phrases.english: 4.O He whose aid is far from the wrongdoers! You knowest,

phrases.arabic: يَا إلهِي  مَا نالَنِي مِنْ [فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَن] مِمَّا حَظَرْتَ
phrases.english: 5.my God, how so-and-so, son of so-and-so, has harmed me in that which You hast forbidden,

phrases.arabic: وَانْتَهَكَهُ مِنّي مِمَّا حَجَزْتَ عَلَيْهِ بَطَراً فِي نِعْمَتِكَ عِنْدَهُ وَاغْتِرَاراً بِنَكِيرِكَ عَلَيْهِ
phrases.english: 6.and how he has violated me in that which You hast prohibited, showing thereby ingratitude toward Your favour upon him and delusion concerning what You hast denied him.

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 7.O God, so bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَخُذْ ظَالِمِي وَعَدُوِّي عَنْ ظُلْمِي بِقُوَّتِكَ
phrases.english: 8.keep my wrongdoing enemy from wronging me through Your strength,

phrases.arabic: وَافْلُلْ حَدَّهُ عَنِّي بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَاجْعَلْ لَهُ
phrases.english: 9.blunt his blade toward me through Your power, and assign to him

phrases.arabic: شُغْلاً فِيَما يَلِيهِ وَعَجْزاً عَمَّا يُناوِيْهِ
phrases.english: 10.a diversion in that which is close to him and the inability to reach his enemy!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 11.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تُسَوِّغْ لَهُ ظُلْمِي وَأَحْسِنْ عَلَيْـهِ عَوْنِي،
phrases.english: 12.let the wrongdoer not find it easy to wrong me, give me good help against him,

phrases.arabic: وَاعْصِمْنِي مِنْ مِثْـلِ أَفْعَالِهِ، وَلا تَجْعَلْنِي فِي مِثْلِ حَالِهِ.
phrases.english: 13.preserve me from the like of his acts, and place me not in the like of his situation!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ ،
phrases.english: 14.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَأَعِدْنِي عَلَيْهِ عَدْوى حَاضِرَةً  تَكُونُ مِنْ غَيْظِي بِهِ شِفَاءً،
phrases.english: 15.and assist me with an immediate assistance that will heal my rage toward him

phrases.arabic: وَمِنْ حَنَقِي عَلَيْهِ وَفَاءً.
phrases.english: 16.and redeem my fury toward him!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 17.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَعَوِّضْنِي مِنْ ظُلْمِهِ لِي عَفْوَكَ،
phrases.english: 18.compensate me for his wronging me with Your pardon

phrases.arabic: وَأَبْدِلْنِي بِسُوْءِ صنِيعِهِ بِيْ رَحْمَتَكَ،
phrases.english: 19.and replace his evil action toward me with Your mercy,

phrases.arabic: فَكُلُّ مَكْرُوه جَلَلٌ دُونَ سَخَطِكَ،
phrases.english: 20.for every detested thing less than Your anger is slight

phrases.arabic: وَكُلُّ مُرْزِئَةٍ سَوَاءٌ مَعَ مَوْجِدَتِكَ.
phrases.english: 21.and every disaster next to Your rancour indifferent!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا كَـرَّهْتَ إلَيَّ أَنْ أَظْلِمَ فَقِنِي مِنْ أَنْ أُظْلَمَ.
phrases.english: 22.O God, just as You hast made me detest being wronged, so also protect me from doing wrong!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ لاَ أَشْكُو إلَى أَحَد سِوَاكَ،
phrases.english: 23.O God, I complain to no one but You,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ أَسْتَعِينُ بِحَاكِم غَيْرِكَ حَاشَاكَ
phrases.english: 24.and I seek help from no ruler other than You - how could I?

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ،
phrases.english: 25.So bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَصِلْ دُعَائِي بِالإِجَابَةِ، وَأَقْرِنْ شِكَايَتِي بِالتَّغْيِيرِ.
phrases.english: 26.join my supplication to response, and unite my complaint with change!

phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ لا تَفْتِنِّي بِالْقُنُوطِ مِنْ إنْصَافِكَ،
phrases.english: 27.O God, tempt me not with despair of Your just treatment

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَفْتِنْـهُ بِالأَمْنِ مِنْ إنْكَارِكَ،
phrases.english: 28.and tempt him not with feeling secure from Your disapproval,

phrases.arabic: فَيُصِرَّ عَلَى ظُلْمِي وَيُحَاضِرَنِي بِحَقِّيْ
phrases.english: 29.lest he persist in wronging me and constrain me in my rights.

phrases.arabic: وَعَرِّفْهُ عَمَّا قَلِيْل مَا أَوْعَدْتَ الظَّالِمِينَ،
phrases.english: 30.Let him soon recognize what You hast promised the wrongdoers

phrases.arabic: وَعَرِّفْنِي مَا وَعَدْتَ مِنْ إجَابَةِ الْمُضْطَرِّينَ.
phrases.english: 31.and let me recognize Your promised response to the distressed!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ،
phrases.english: 32.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَوَفِّقْنِي لِقَبُولِ مَا قَضَيْتَ لِيْ وَعَليَّ،
phrases.english: 33.give me success in accepting Your decrees for me and against me,

phrases.arabic: وَرَضِّنِيْ بِمَا أَخَذْتَ لي وَمِنِّي
phrases.english: 34.make me pleased with what You takest for me and from me,

phrases.arabic: وَاهْـدِنِي لِلَّتِيْ هِي أَقْوَمُ وَاسْتَعْمِلْنِي بِمَا هُوَ أَسْلَمُ.
phrases.english: 35.guide me to that which is most upright and employ me in that which is safest!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنْ كَانَتِ الْخِيَرَةُ لِيْ عِنْدَكَ
phrases.english: 36.O God, if the best for me with You lies

phrases.arabic: فِي تَأْخِيرِ الأَخْذِ لِي وَتَرْكِ الانْتِقَامِ
phrases.english: 37.in delaying the taking to task for my sake of him

phrases.arabic: مِمَّنْ ظَلَمَنِيْ إلَى يَوْمِ الْفَصْلِ وَمَجْمَعِ الْخَصْمِ،
phrases.english: 38.who has wronged me and in refraining from vengeance toward him until the Day of Decision and the Gathering of Disputants,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ ،
phrases.english: 39.then bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَأَيِّدْنِي مِنْكَ بِنِيَّة صَادِقَة وَصَبْر دَائِم،
phrases.english: 40.strengthen me from You with true intention and lasting patience,

phrases.arabic: وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْ سُوءِ الرَّغْبَةِ، وَهَلَعِ أَهْلِ الْحِرْصِ،
phrases.english: 41.give me refuge from evil desire and the impatience of the greedy

phrases.arabic: وَصَوِّرْ فِي قَلْبِي مِثَالَ مَا ادَّخَـرْتَ لِي مِنْ ثَوَابِـكَ،
phrases.english: 42.and form in my heart the image of Your reward

phrases.arabic: وَأَعْدَدْتَ لِخَصْمِي مِنْ جَزَائِكَ وَعِقَابِكَ ،
phrases.english: 43.which You hast stored away for me and the repayment and punishment

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ سَبَباً لِقَنَاعَتِي بِمَا قَضَيْتَ ،
phrases.english: 44.which You has prepared for my disputant! Make this a cause of my contentment with what You hast decreed

phrases.arabic: وَثِقَتِي بِمَا تَخَيَّرْتَ، آمِينَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ ،
phrases.english: 45.and my trust in what You hast chosen! Amen, Lord of the worlds!

phrases.arabic: إنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ  الْعَظِيمِ ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ .
phrases.english: 46.You art of bounty abounding and You art powerful over everything.
